text: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.
Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will Page 322 Page 323 bless his people with peace. Psalm 30 A Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house of David.
Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield. Psalm 6 To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David. Page 310 Page 311
Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him. greet you.
Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.
And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.
The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah. Psalm 47 To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.
He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.
Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that he might be glorified.
The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.

And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.
And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?
For with God nothing shall be impossible.
Seek ye the LORD, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD’S anger.
So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.
The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.
Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
That Christ may dwell in Page 674 your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate. Psalm 35 A Psalm of David.
This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
There shall not any man be able to stand before thee all the days of thy life: as I was with Moses, so I will be with thee: I will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed. Page 50
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
I in them, and thou in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that thou hast sent me, and hast loved them, as thou hast loved me.
There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
When thou saidst, Seek ye my face; my heart said unto thee, Thy face, LORD, will I seek.

For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ’s sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

Is not the LORD your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD, and before his people.
He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.
And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD. Psalm 28 A Psalm of David.
They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovah-shalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites.
Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD. Psalm 32 A Psalm of David, Maschil.
He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.
The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.
Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work: for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts:
Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD, and whose hope the LORD is.
For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,
Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God. Psalm 43
Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.
Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
And as they thus spake, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety. Psalm 5 To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.
I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
Trust in the LORD, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
O LORD, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
For thus saith the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.
Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.
LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.
Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
But the LORD is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen. Page 579
O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy Page 680 communication out of your mouth.
And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD: for the day of the LORD is at hand: for the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, he hath bid his guests.
What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he is their help and their shield.
And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear ye me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin; The LORD is with you, while ye be with him; and if ye seek him, he will be found of you; but if ye forsake him, he will forsake you.
Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD.
And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
But it is good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works. Psalm 74 Maschil of Asaph.
The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.
Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence. Psalm 141 A Psalm of David.

Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.
Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
